notes: Two things at once. It demands 5+ years, which analyze@2 must route to redFlags rather than to a gap entry. And it asks for C#, which the candidate genuinely has through Unity game development — so the analysis should credit the language while still naming the missing ASP.NET and Azure ecosystem. A model that either ignores the Unity C# or treats it as enterprise backend experience is wrong in opposite directions.
jobDescription:
Senior .NET Developer (Athens, Hybrid)

We modernise core banking integrations for financial institutions.

What you will do:
- Design and build services in C# with ASP.NET Core
- Work with Entity Framework Core against SQL Server
- Deploy to Azure App Service and Azure Functions
- Integrate with message queues (Azure Service Bus)
- Mentor two mid-level developers and lead design reviews

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional .NET development
- Strong C# fundamentals including async programming
- Production experience with Azure
- Experience in regulated environments is an advantage

Compensation is discussed at the interview stage.
